comments.author: Blake.C
comments.body:
+1 to Alchemy, goes into the weapon/hand slot. Has 100 dura, requires 20k fame to equip, carries no effect. Most importantly, it gives the R15 effect of increasing Nanban trade rates.

Obtained as a reward for completing the "Alchemy Experiment Result (No.1)" MA

it's very hard to do

comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
It is indeed and I strongly recommend "Adept" title (R13+ alchemy base) if you go for this.

Another side note, this book has no weapon category and thus can be only fixed through world tarot card.
